description: Batch flow proof: up to 25 flows, each traced on the source configuration and on the converted target by the deterministic packet-tracer simulate_flow uses. Each flow returns same, different (with the named differences, e.g. verdict or post-NAT address) or untestable (with the reason: a group or unknown name, an invalid address, a blocked job, an unresolved path), plus each side's verdict, deciding rule and NAT. More than 25 flows is refused (invalid_args: too_many_flows). Returns addresses, so it is hidden in strict view. Read-only; no AI call. Unknown fields are refused (invalid_args).

description: A numbered method of procedure (MOP) for this conversion job, assembled from its stored facts: readiness first (BLOCKED or NEEDS_REVIEW says so and lists the holds before any push step; BLOCKED gets no push, verify or rollback steps), pre-checks, manual steps, the push order of the configuration sections the job emitted, verify commands for the features it carries (NAT, VPN, routing, VLANs), the go/no-go rule and rollback. Commands come from NetConverter's KB templates for the target platform (PAN-OS set and XML, FortiOS, Junos set and hierarchical, AOS-CX, IOS-XE); any other target returns a not_covered section instead of guessed commands. No configuration text. Deterministic, no AI, read-only. Unknown fields are refused (invalid_args).

annotations.title: Re-run a job on the current engine

description: RE-RUN (write; flag-gated per tenant) — queue a new conversion of this finished job (tra_…) on the CURRENT engine with the same stored source, the same options and the same decisions. The source configuration and the decisions are copied server-side and never cross this surface. Returns new_job_id, the engine that built the base job (base_engine) and the current one. When the new job completes, call diff_runs(job_a=<this job>, job_b=new_job_id) to see what changed. Refusals: job_not_finished (queued or processing), not_a_conversion (a prescan converts with submit_conversion). Pass idempotency_key to make a retry safe (same key within 24 h returns the same job).

job_id.description: Job id (tra_… or val_… where supported). Validation jobs require an explicit id. Optional for a conversion chosen with select_job; an explicit value wins for this call only.

description: DIFF (read) — what changed between two runs of a conversion, typically a job and its rerun_job: job and translation status, the engine that built each, checkpoint (CP) and behaviour-check (BC) verdicts that differ, counts with deltas (rules, objects, zones, assurance counts, findings), finding codes added / removed / changed, and a bounded unified diff of the emitted configuration lines (credentials redacted). In the strict view the emitted lines are withheld (counts only); a BLOCKED run's configuration is never shown. Both jobs must belong to this account.

job_a.description: The earlier run (e.g. the stale job).

title: What changed between two runs
